summary: Morphs between up to sixteen SOP shapes with matching topology, optionally blending positions, colors, normals, texture coordinates, and other attributes.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Point or primitive group in the first input to blend

key_params.name: diff
key_params.note: Use differencing mode for exaggerated values outside 0-1

key_params.name: input0weight
key_params.note: Blend weight for an input; additional input weights follow the same pattern

common_gotchas: All blend sources need the same point/CV and face counts for predictable morphs.
Point order matters; mismatched ordering can twist or drag parts across the model.
In differencing mode the first input is a base reference, so its blend channel does not exaggerate that input.
Only inputs with non-zero weights cook, so muted blend sources may not update until weighted.
key_concepts: Blend SOP morphs between up to sixteen SOP inputs with matching topology.
Source point/CV counts, face counts, and point order must match for predictable blending.
Individual toggles control whether positions, colors, normals, texture coordinates, and other attributes are blended.
Differencing mode treats the first input as a base reference and allows exaggerated values outside the 0-1 range.
